description: This file defines a React functional component 'ViewDetailsModal' that renders a generic modal to display detailed JSON data. It handles formatting of labels and values, with special handling for user cost related data. The component utilizes various utility functions for currency and label formatting, and renders the data in a stylized, scrollable modal window.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal displaying key-value pairs from the provided data object, with formatting and special handling for user cost keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Helper function within the component to format and render each value based on its type and key, including special display for user cost keys.

methods.name: toNumberLike
methods.description: Converts a value into a number representing USD amount, using utility function parseUsdToNumber.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a given key loosely matches patterns associated with user cost data, case-insensitive.
